description: Every route that also answers anonymously, and the one answer each gives a PRESENTED credential that does not authenticate. An absent credential gets the anonymous view (`anonymousStatus`); a malformed, forged (well-formed, never issued) or revoked bearer gets `answer` — never the anonymous view, and the same answer for all three, so a credential cannot be probed. `{publicSpace}` is a public space the law creates. `invalidBodies` are near misses a client must refuse (Ajv oracle).
